newsitem.title: UK: Syrian Light August crude price set 10 cts higher.
newsitem.headline: Syrian Light August crude price set 10 cts higher.

text.p: Syrian state oil company Sytrol and term contract holders have agreed a price of Dated Brent -45 cents for August liftings of Syrian Light crude, up 10 cents from July, traders said.
The absence of Iraqi crude in the last two months has boosted values in the Mediterranean sour crude market.
The price is a compromise between Sytrol's initial asking price of Dated Brent -40 cents, and buyers' requests for a rollover of the July price of Dated Brent -55 cents.
The August price for Syria's heavy Souedie grade has yet to be decided, with discussion around the Dated Brent -$3.85 level, traders said.
